source_caption:
📺 Friends (1994–2004)

Friends follows six close friends—Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler, and Ross—as they navigate the hilarious ups and downs of life in New York City. From complicated relationships and awkward dates to career struggles, unforgettable adventures, and everyday misunderstandings, the group shares countless memorable moments while supporting one another through life’s biggest challenges. Whether they’re hanging out at Central Perk, spending time in Monica’s apartment, or dealing with unexpected romantic drama, their friendship remains at the heart of everything. Combining laugh-out-loud comedy, heartwarming moments, iconic characters, and unforgettable storylines, the series explores love, friendship, personal growth, and the importance of having people who are always there for you.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Romance • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 8.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~22 minutes per episode • 10 seasons • 236 episodes

🎥 Creators: David Crane and Marta Kauffman

🏆 Recognition: Starring Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry, and David Schwimmer, the series won six Primetime Emmy Awards, including Outstanding Comedy Series, and became one of the most beloved sitcoms in television history.

📺 Where to Watch: HBO Max • Amazon Prime Video • Apple TV (digital purchase). Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Friends is an American television sitcom created by David Crane and Marta Kauffman, which aired on NBC from September 22, 1994, to May 6, 2004, lasting ten seasons. With an ensemble cast starring Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry, and David Schwimmer, the show revolves around six friends in their 20s and early 30s who live in Manhattan, New York City. The original executive producers were Kevin S. Bright, Kauffman, and Crane. Kauffman and Crane began developing Friends under the working title Insomnia Cafe between November and December 1993.
